name: Mailu
description: Insular email distribution - mail server as Docker images
readme_summary: Mailu is a comprehensive, free, and open-source email server solution distributed as Docker images. It provides standard and advanced email functionalities, web access, and robust security features, making it easy to set up and maintain a private email server.
primary_use_case: Self-hosting a private, feature-rich, and secure email server using Docker.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, modern post office building constructed from interconnected Docker containers. Inside, friendly robots are efficiently sorting and delivering mail (represented by glowing envelopes) to various digital inboxes (represented by illuminated mail slots). One robot is shown applying a digital seal of security (like a shield or lock icon) to outgoing mail, while another scans incoming mail with a magnifying glass that reveals data patterns. The overall scene is clean, bright, and organized, with subtle UI elements and data streams flowing between the containers, hinting at the underlying software. The Mailu logo is subtly integrated into the building's signage. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a friendly, approachable aesthetic.

name: browsr
description: 🗂️ a pleasant file explorer in your terminal supporting all filesystems
readme_summary: Browsr is a Python-based terminal file explorer that allows users to navigate and interact with local and remote filesystems. It supports various cloud storage services and offers features like syntax highlighting, JSON formatting, and data table rendering.
key_features: Integrates with GitHub, SSH, AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage
Data file conversion to navigable datatables
primary_use_case: Navigating and managing files across diverse local and remote storage systems directly from the terminal.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic filing cabinet with a glowing screen on its front, actively sorting and organizing a chaotic stream of digital documents and data packets flowing from various sources like clouds, servers, and code repositories. The filing cabinet has multiple drawers labeled 'Local', 'S3', 'GitHub', 'SSH', each neatly organizing the incoming data. Subtle UI elements showing file previews and data tables appear on the screen. The scene is set in a clean, organized digital space with soft, ambient lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, friendly colors and clear, intuitive iconography, emphasizing ease of access and organization.

name: AirGuard
description: Protect yourself from being tracked 🌍 by AirTags 🏷 and Find My accessories 📍
readme_summary: AirGuard is an Android application designed to protect users from unwanted tracking by Apple AirTags and other Find My compatible devices. It scans the surroundings for these trackers and notifies the user if a device is following them, allowing them to locate and disable it.
key_features: Detects AirTags and other Find My devices
Allows users to play a sound on detected AirTags
Voluntary participation in a research study
primary_use_case: Protecting Android users from being covertly tracked by Apple AirTags and similar devices.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, vigilant Android robot character holding a magnifying glass, scanning the air around it. The magnifying glass reveals faint, glowing outlines of Apple AirTags hidden in everyday objects like a backpack and a car. A subtle notification icon appears above the robot's head. The background is a softly blurred cityscape, suggesting the user is out and about. Small, abstract data streams flow from the AirTags towards the robot, representing detection. The overall mood is one of awareness and protection. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a friendly color palette.

name: arozos
description: Web Desktop Operating System for low power platforms, Now written in Go!
readme_summary: ArozOS is a web-based desktop operating system designed for low-power platforms like Raspberry Pi. It provides a user-friendly interface with features for file management, networking, and security, aiming to create a personal cloud or home server experience.
key_features: Static Web Server with built-in editor
Mount Local and Remote File Systems (WebDAV, SMB, SFTP)
Build-in Network File Sharing Servers (FTP, WebDAV, SFTP)
Support for low system memory (512MB) and storage (1.5GB)
primary_use_case: To provide a functional and user-friendly desktop operating system experience on low-power devices, enabling them to act as personal cloud storage, home servers, or network-attached storage solutions.
cover_image_prompt: A miniature, vibrant cityscape built on a single, glowing Raspberry Pi. Tiny houses and buildings represent different applications and services, all connected by glowing data streams. A central tower, labeled 'ArozOS', acts as a hub, with digital 'workers' (abstract figures) managing data flow. Small, stylized icons for file sharing, web serving, and network monitoring float around the city. The overall mood is futuristic and organized, with a clean, 3D isometric illustration style and a bright, inviting color palette, emphasizing a powerful, accessible home cloud experience.

name: botasaurus
description: The All in One Framework to Build Undefeatable Scrapers
readme_summary: Botasaurus is a Python web scraping framework designed to build robust and undetectable scrapers. It simplifies complex tasks like bypassing bot detection systems and CAPTCHAs, offering features for human-like interaction, parallel processing, and cost reduction.
key_features: Bypass Cloudflare, BrowserScan, Fingerprint, Datadome bot detection
Convert scrapers into desktop apps (Mac, Windows, Linux)
Reduce proxy costs with browser-based fetch requests
Easy parallelization, profiles, extensions, and proxy configuration
Utilities for caching, sitemap, and data cleaning
primary_use_case: Building undetectable web scrapers that can bypass advanced bot detection mechanisms.
cover_image_prompt: A master locksmith, depicted as a friendly robot with a toolbox, effortlessly picking a complex, glowing lock labeled 'Cloudflare'. The lock is integrated into a digital wall representing the internet. Around the robot, data streams flow smoothly, transforming from chaotic code into organized, valuable information represented by shining gems. Subtle UI elements showing 'undetected' status and 'human-like' mouse cursors are visible on a small holographic screen. The scene is set in a futuristic, clean workshop with soft, digital lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant blues and golds, emphasizing ease and success.

name: clip-finder
description: AI-powered YouTube search. Index any channel, playlist, or video and search through transcripts with natural language. Uses Gemini embeddings + ChromaDB for semantic search. Click any result to jump to the exact timestamp. React + FastAPI + LangChain. Self-hosted, BYOK (bring your own key).
readme_summary: SearchTube is an AI-powered tool for semantic search of YouTube video transcripts. It allows users to index entire channels, playlists, or individual videos and then search through their content using natural language queries. The results provide exact timestamp links to the relevant moments in the videos.
key_features: Semantic transcript search with timestamped YouTube links
Local BYOK support via browser storage
Hosted server-key mode with optional encrypted BYOK/hybrid modes
Library browser, transcript downloads, result count controls, and recent search history
Retrieval eval harness for testing embedding changes before changing defaults
primary_use_case: Enabling users to quickly find specific information within YouTube videos by searching their transcripts semantically and jumping directly to the relevant timestamp.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian standing in a vast, digital library filled with glowing YouTube play buttons. The librarian holds a magical magnifying glass that, when focused on a play button, reveals a shimmering timeline with highlighted moments. The magnifying glass projects a search query bubble with simple text, and the timeline instantly zooms into a specific point. Subtle data streams flow from the play buttons to the librarian's desk, where a small, clean UI displays search results. The overall mood is one of discovery and effortless information retrieval. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant, tech-inspired color palette.
